problems.title: Min Cost to Connect All Points
problems.notes: Prim's or Kruskal's MST on a complete graph of Manhattan distances — Prim's with a heap avoids materializing all n^2 edges

problems.title: Connecting Cities With Minimum Cost
problems.notes: textbook Kruskal's with union-find; sort edges by cost, union until n-1 edges are used or it's infeasible

problems.title: Minimum Score of a Path Between Two Cities
problems.notes: union-find grouping + track the minimum edge weight per component — MST machinery repurposed for a min-over-component query

problems.title: Find Critical and Pseudo-Critical Edges in Minimum Spanning Tree
problems.notes: run Kruskal's with each edge force-included and force-excluded in turn, compare the resulting MST weight to the baseline

problems.title: Swim in Rising Water
problems.notes: binary search + BFS, or a Prim's-flavored 'minimax path' using a min-heap of the next lowest reachable cell

problems.title: Optimize Water Distribution in a Village
problems.notes: reframe as MST with a virtual source node 0, where a well's cost becomes the weight of an edge from node 0

problems.title: Maximum Students Taking Exam
problems.notes: bitmask DP that's conceptually bipartite-matching-adjacent: row-by-row transitions between compatible seat masks
